words.definition: able to be done, usually referring to something you can do without damage or loss
words.example: The new dictionary is quite affordable.
words.zh: 能夠完成，通常指的是你可以做而不會造成損壞或損失的事情

words.definition: to make something impure by adding something dirty or a poisonous substance
words.example: This contaminated water supply must be closed off to the public.
words.zh: 透過添加骯髒的東西或有毒的物質來使東西變得不純淨

words.example: A feeling of anxiety was discernible among the members of the team.
The flourishing community garden produced enough vegetables for several local families.
The evidence was insufficient to support the claim, so the study continued.

words.definition: to support; to keep in good condition
words.example: The building had to be renovated because it was not well maintained.

words.definition: of average quality; not good or bad
words.example: This is a mediocre research report.

words.definition: to ignore; to give little attention
words.example: The amount of bacteria in the culture was negligible.

words.definition: being almost of the same type or time; comparable
words.example: There were many parallels between his life and mine.
words.zh: 幾乎具有相同的類型或時間；可比

words.example: He gave a potent speech at the convention.

words.definition: to give something or express a feeling in return
words.example: When neighboring villages shared food after the flood, the town promised to reciprocate their kindness.
words.zh: 給予某物或表達某種感覺作為回報

words.example: The invention of the radio was a remarkable achievement.
Hurricane Andrew left debris scattered throughout Miami.
They feel somewhat tired after the mile run.

words.definition: to emerge or develop from something
words.example: The author's talent in writing stems.
The tedious lecture bored most of the audience.
